in_marathi.name: कमल
in_marathi.long_meaning: कमल हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the lotus symbolizes purity, enlightenment, and spiritual growth. The lotus flower rises above the water, untouched by its murky depths, representing the individual's ability to rise above their worldly desires and achieve spiritual enlightenment.

in_bengali.name: कमल

The lotus flower rises above the water, untouched by its murky depths, representing the individual's ability to rise above their worldly desires and achieve spiritual enlightenment.
